about: Per game mode, keyed by the event name /events/[slug] knows it by: what it is, how it unlocks, what it rewards, its CN and Global launches, the official source, and the poster, panels and guide links the mode page shows.

[Reclamation Algorithm] Relaunch Anchor.title: Reclamation Algorithm: Relaunch Anchor
description: A permanent Reclamation Algorithm theme focused on building New Rhodes Island on Victoria’s southeastern border.
Clear stages to earn Mission Acceptance Slips and redeem them at the Rhodes Island Procurement Center.
[Reclamation Algorithm] Relaunch Anchor.rewards: Mountain’s The Hardcore Rider outfit, the Relaunch background, Reclamation Endures icon, Algorithm profile theme and Blueprint of Rebuild interactive furniture.

panels.title: Rebuilding New Rhodes Island
